category: rotating residential and static ISP proxy
tier: Residential Proxies (per GB) and Static ISP (per IP)

free_tier.stated: Residential from $0.38/GB and ISP proxy from $1.80/IP on the home page, with 'Start Free Trial' on the sign-up button. The FAQ limits that: 'Some plans include a free trial. You can contact our online support to claim it for free.'
free_tier.notes: The trial size is not stated on any page read: unverified: behind a contact.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an address or a traffic quota, not an object

retention.stated: not applicable: a proxy session or a rented address, not stored bytes

egress.terms: Residential traffic is billed per GB with larger plans cheaper per GB and custom pricing above 10 TB; static ISP plans are 'priced by IP and rental period, with no additional charges based on traffic usage'.

interface_detail: HTTPS, HTTP and SOCKS5; residential sessions are sticky for 1 to 120 minutes or rotate on every request; static ISP plans support HTTP(S) and SOCKS5.
tooling: Any client that speaks an HTTP(S) or SOCKS5 proxy with a username and password or an allowlisted source address: curl -x, python requests, rclone --socks5, or a host-side hop for a runtime that cannot dial a proxy itself.
chaining: A host-side hop dials the vendor's HTTP(S) or SOCKS5 endpoint with credentials; the upstream sees an address from the vendor's pool in place of the caller's address.

limits.value: Residential from $0.38/GB; contact sales above 10 TB
Unlimited Traffic - Port plan: 6 Mbps per port from $0.38/port/day; Unlimited Traffic - Bandwidth plan from $19.67/day

limits_note: Static ISP sample rows on the pricing page show a 'Broadcast ISP' address in Johor Bahru, Malaysia under AS7361 (DataZone Networks LLC) and a 'Native ISP' address in Seoul under AS9848 (Sejong Networks), both labelled 'Home Bandwidth IP' with a 'Risk Score' of 8% and 5%; the addresses are masked, so no registry lookup of an address was possible. A RIPE Stat lookup of the two ASNs gave holders DATAZONE - DataZone Networks LLC (ARIN) and SejongTelecom-AS-KR-KR - SEJONG NETWORKS (APNIC).
binding_note: The residential product is metered per GB; the static ISP product is per IP and rental period with no traffic fee.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page asks for a password of 8 to 20 characters and an emailed 'Verification code', with a Google sign-in alternative; no phone, card or identity document is on the form. Payment is by card, cryptocurrency, Alipay or bank transfer.

reliability_note: https://www.fluxisp.com/ resolves to zooproxy.com, so the FluxISP name now maps to this vendor. The 'Broadcast ISP' sample is registered to a hosting-style AS (DataZone Networks) while its 'IP Category' reads 'Home Bandwidth IP'; the registration class of any live exit was not checked (rung 5).
confidence_note: Prices, session rules, sign-up fields and payment methods are from the vendor's pages; the pool and class labels are vendor statements; the two ASN holders are a registry lookup of the vendor's published sample rows.

evidence.proved: Residential proxies start at $0.38 per GB.
The static ISP proxy starts at $1.80 per IP.

evidence.quote: ZooProxy helps businesses collect data, maintain stable sessions, and handle high-traffic workloads with reliable proxy access across different markets.
evidence.proved: The FluxISP domain serves the ZooProxy site: its final URL is zooproxy.com, so both names are one vendor.

evidence.quote: Some plans include a free trial. You can contact our online support to claim it for free.
evidence.proved: A trial exists by request to support.

evidence.quote: We support payment methods such as credit cards, cryptocurrencies, Alipay, and bank card transfers.
evidence.proved: Payment rails are card, crypto, Alipay and bank transfer.

evidence.quote: Sticky IP: The IP remains fixed for 1–120 minutes and rotates automatically upon expiration.

evidence.proved: The sign-up form asks for an emailed verification code.

evidence.quote: The difference is whether the IP registration location matches its internet egress, affecting account risk control and cost.
evidence.proved: The vendor separates 'Native ISP' from 'Broadcast ISP' by whether registration and egress locations match.

evidence.quote: If you need more than 10TB of traffic, contact our sales team for custom pricing based on your traffic requirements.
evidence.proved: Residential pricing is custom above 10 TB.

notes: Named on a Chinese-language proxy forum as FluxISP ('动态住宅低至$0.4/GB, 静态ISP独享IP'); the vendor now trades as ZooProxy.

extras.rung_note: The static ISP line claims to clear rung 5 (registration class); only the two sample ASNs were looked up, not a live exit.
